description: The Dependency Dashboard is off: nothing here uses dependencyDashboardApproval or a concurrency limit, so the issue only ever restated what the open PR list already showed.

GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs: a tag can be moved to other code, a SHA cannot. Pins track full versions (`# v7.0.1`) rather than floating majors, so each update is a new release tag that the release-age hold can date.

packageRules.description: pnpm 11 rejects lockfile entries published within the last day (`minimumReleaseAge`), so an npm update raised sooner fails CI until it ages. Three days rather than one matches automerge's hold, so the two presets agree in either extend order.

Every npm update rewrites pnpm-lock.yaml, so separate PRs conflict as soon as one merges. One group shares one lockfile change; majors stay separate for review. Under automerge, a 0.x minor in the group holds the whole PR for a human.

Each action update rewrites a `uses:` line, and those lines sit side by side, so separate PRs conflict as soon as one merges. One group carries them together; majors stay separate for review. Pins carry Renovate's built-in `pin-dependencies` slug, so `groupSlug` is set to keep them in the group. Under automerge, a pin, `digest` or 0.x minor in the group holds the whole PR for a human.
